name: com.xlx.speech.voicereadsdk.ui.activity.landing.mall.SpeechVoiceTiktokMallBottomPopupLandingActivity
description: The Xinliangxiang voice-read SDK opens this screen when a user taps the bottom offer in a short-video shopping ad. It shows the product's pop-up offer and its next action.
